intent: A late-gothic marsh-court gown: a bone-V cuirass over a fen-green bodice and a narrow reed belt above a wide six-gored bell skirt lamed in reed straw all round and edged in bog iron, with a winged reed circlet, reading from the high camera as a narrow green top over a wide gold-striped bell.
requests: A hollow cone or annulus skirt primitive: the bell is six flat gores a leg because a solid cylinder caps flat and a box cannot taper.
